scope: Legacy Section 5.1.3 modified Base64 payload transform only; UTF-16 conversion, shifts, and mailbox grammar excluded

requirements.decision: Use standard Base64 bit grouping with comma in place of slash and no equals padding.
Accept and return already-converted UTF-16BE octets, reject odd decoded byte lengths, and leave Unicode conversion and scalar validation to the caller.
Validate exact case-sensitive alphabet bytes, forbid padding, and require canonical trailing bits without normalization.
Expose payload bytes only; do not emit ampersand/hyphen shifts, encode printable ASCII policy, convert Unicode, or claim complete mailbox syntax.
